Remark
[explicit algebraic rewriting of the scalar-flat and Schwarzschild metrics]

Source: petersen:page-0175 ↗ ex:pet-ch4-scalar-flat-tautological-bundle ↗ prop:pet-ch4-schwarzschild-ricci-flat 1. ch4:4.7.15Show $\big(\tfrac 14\rho _0^2+r^{2-n}\big)^{\frac{n-2}2}g_{\mathbb {R}^n} =\tfrac 1{1-(\rho _0/\rho )^{n-2}}d\rho ^2+\rho ^2ds_{n-1}^2$, the scalar-flat metric of equation 4; use this to rewrite the Schwarzschild metric of subsection 2.5 algebraically in terms of the flat metric on $\mathbb {R}^{n-1}$ and a conformal factor.
